settings.text: The structured top-handle bag, in premium top-grain leather with gold-tone hardware. Three sizes, forty colors — carried by hand or on the shoulder.

settings.title: Details
settings.content: Designed for the woman who wants the look of a five-figure bag without the five figures, the Leather Handbag is built from premium top-grain leather in the structured silhouette that has defined modern luxury for decades. The iconic gold-tone twist lock and double rolled handles do the talking, while an adjustable shoulder strap lets you carry it by hand or on the shoulder. Inside, a spacious main compartment with a zip pocket and a slip pocket keeps cards, phone, and everyday essentials in order. Lightweight, durable, and quietly expensive-looking, it carries from the office to dinner to the weekend. Choose from three sizes and forty colors — there's one for every outfit, and a few you'll want to collect.

settings.title: Materials & Care
settings.content:
Leather: Premium top-grain leather with a natural pebbled grain.
Hardware: Gold-tone twist lock with protective metal base feet.
Handles: Double rolled top handles, plus an adjustable shoulder strap.
Interior: One main compartment, one zip pocket, one slip pocket.

Care: Wipe with a soft, dry cloth and condition occasionally with a leather balm. Avoid prolonged moisture and direct heat. Store stuffed and upright to hold its shape.

settings.title: Dimensions & Fit
settings.content:
Width measured across the base:

Mini: 20 cm (7.9")  |  Small: 25 cm (9.8")  |  Medium: 30 cm (11.8")

What fits: the Mini holds phone, cardholder, and keys; the Small adds a compact wallet and sunglasses; the Medium carries a tablet and your everyday essentials with room to spare. All three include an adjustable shoulder strap.

settings.title: Shipping & Returns
settings.content:
Free shipping on all orders over $75. Once your order is placed, it ships and arrives within 7 to 10 business days.

We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for items in original, unused condition with all tags attached. Exchanges are always free.

settings.title: Two Year Warranty
settings.content:
Every Velantra bag is covered for two years against defects in materials and construction. If anything goes wrong in normal use, we’ll repair or replace it.

After two years, we continue to offer repair service for the cost of materials. Designed to last decades, not seasons.

settings.headline: The Icon, in Leather You Can Actually Afford
settings.body:
We took the structured top-handle silhouette that's defined luxury for half a century and rebuilt it in premium top-grain leather with gold-tone hardware — for a fraction of what the designer originals command. It carries with the same presence, minus the four-figure price tag.

Available in three sizes and forty colors, from timeless Black to Rouge to deep green. Quietly expensive-looking, and entirely yours.
